resources.string: Preview the saved metadata for one bot turn. Copying is optional. Opening this view does not send or check a message.

not_recorded means no saved record. Message time is the local post timestamp in UTC, not a send/ACK timestamp. The endpoint is the archive configuration, not a captured request. Earlier versions did not retain turn save times or ACK details.
